roster_note: Standalone obelisk, wall of names, eternal-flame plinth on a paved terrace. Civic gravity without national emblems.
civic_program: a paved terrace approached on a single axis
a tall plain obelisk or monolith on the axis
a wall of names flanking the approach
an eternal-flame plinth at the foot of the monument
low planting and benches at the terrace edge
a boundary of standard fencing and lamp standards
circulation: the approach is axial and unobstructed
damage_constraints: the flame is out and the plinth is cracked; the monument and the wall of names stand
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the site carries civic weight without any national emblem
